part.title: Remove Bot
part.description:
If you remove the bot, ALL of your data will be permanently deleted.

This includes:
• Custom Commands
• Command settings (enabled/disabled)
• Live notifications
• 7TV / Twitch features (badges, emotes, paints)
• Reminders & saved data

For security, you will receive a code that you must enter.
After removal, you will be automatically logged out.
